text:
Ari Patel: Morning — final edits for the Integration Onramp playbook. Quick checklist: launch blog post, joint webinar, marketplace listing, lead routing, benchmark one-pager. Aim to publish Wed 9am PT. Who can own the marketplace listing copy?

Maya Chen: I can draft marketplace copy. Need product bullets + allowed logos from partner. ETA EOD Tue.

Jon Rivera: I’ll own lead routing mapping to SFDC. Quick Q: do we route partner leads to a separate queue or tag them? Prefer tag + partner queue.

Sasha K: For webinar, partner requested 30m demo + 15m Q&A. We should push 45 minutes total to fit calendars. Also need speaker brief and slide deck by Monday.

Ari Patel: Plan: blog + benchmark narrative drop Wed AM, webinar Thurs afternoon, marketplace goes live same day as blog. Maya — add the benchmark numbers into the blog header (latency/cost comparison, anonymized). Jon — put webhook to /integrations/partner-a in the routing doc.

Maya Chen: Draft blog skeleton: intro, customer pain, benchmark summary, how Redwood solves it, partner integration callout, CTA -> demo/webinar sign-up. Pushing draft to docs: https://app.docs/redwood/pm/integration-onramp

Jon Rivera: SFDC field mapping (quick): utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, partner_name, partner_id, lead_owner -> routing rules. I'll add a fallback rule to assign to "partnerships nurture" if no owner.

Sasha K: Slide ask: one benchmark slide, one architecture slide, one partner product screenshot. Can someone export high-res images? @Maya can you?

Maya Chen: Yep will pull screenshots and export. Also confirm partner logo guidelines — are we allowed to use their full lockup? PartnerLegal flagged a term; will sync.

ProductBot: Deploy note: canary of campaign page set for Tue 17:00 PT. Watch for 502s during warmup.

Jon Rivera: For inbound, propose using webhook + Zapier fallback for partner web forms for first 48h. Then SFDC flow takes over.

Ari Patel: PR plan: internal comms Thu 8am PT, tweet + LinkedIn Thu 9am PT, partner to co-post same hour. Marketing to own H1 copy + hero image. Use UTMs: ?utm_source=partner_onramp&utm_medium=co-marketing&utm_campaign=integration_launch_2026

Sasha K: Rehearsal schedule: Wed 11am PT dry run (15m). Can we lock it? I added calendar invite.

Maya Chen: Draft blog now in docs, pinged product for numbers. Will tag @Jon for the lead form link.

Jon Rivera: Added webhook URL and SFDC mapping to the shared doc. Also set up test lead flow — send a test from staging: ```
curl -X POST https://hooks.redwood.test/partner-a -d '{"email":"test+1@example.com", "utm_campaign":"integration_launch_2026"}'
```

Ari Patel: tiny ask — please include a short benchmark TL;DR (3 bullets) for the press kit. Keep numbers rounded.

Sasha K: Noted. Also we should run one micro-benchmark during rehearsal to verify numbers on slides.

Maya Chen: Legal said partner gave logo clearance if we use "co-branded" lockup; will post final asset in /assets/partners/partner-a by Tue morning.

Jon Rivera: All set from my side. Will monitor the webhook traffic during launch window.

Ari Patel: Thanks team — if no major blockers, moving forward with Wed blog / Thu webinar cadence. :rocket:
